newInstrumentalControls.purpose: Independent instrumental negative controls and chord decoder check; not unseen vocal or language quality

englishCorpus.exposure: All20 recordings and previous heldout have been inspected; this is exposed regression testing, not new heldout evidence

slavicCorpus.additionalSelection: Root recovery manifest, separately frozen; lost original8 must not be claimed reproduced without provenance

lyricSafeguards: Do not infer text from zero/invalid native word timing
Recover individually confident words from a low-logprob window only with valid native alignment evidence and probability>=0.70
SDK/raw native boundary change>0.20seconds becomes an explicitly approximate line, using the envelope of actual native/SDK intervals and words:[]; no compressed exact word time is published
Keep all time coordinates on the untrimmed original recording; no stretching or uniform word redistribution
acceptanceEvidence: Zero lexical lyric words on all15 instrumental controls
EN20 same-native old/new adapter comparison, both lexical and marker-aware WER
Report exact timed-word coverage and common-word paired start/end MAE; no timing improvement claim based solely on a smaller matched subset
Full result accepted by actual app validator
Real shared HTTP smoke before describing profile integrated
modelSelection: Small remains default unless overall text/timing/negative-control/resource evidence justifies another profile. A lower WER alone does not establish better synchronization.
chordChange: Only equal initial HMM priors, with fixed neural weights/dictionary/transitions and exact original frame grid. Compare both decoders on same neural observations; no second-inference runtime attributed.
